short_summary: Searched broadly for upcoming Polokwane-metro events (markets, gigs, sport, heritage, design fairs). WebFetch to almost all external domains was blocked by the network egress proxy this run, limiting verification to WebSearch snippets only, which repeatedly surfaced inconsistent/conflated dates (e.g. Capricorn Heritage Fest vs Doek On Fleek Lekompo Fest) and thin single-aggregator listings (Demi Lee Moore, Hotel & Home Design Fair, SKM Presents, Polokwane Melodic Festival, Botlokwa Braai Festival -- also outside Polokwane metro). Only the recurring Baobab Night Market at Meropa Casino cleared the 3-independent-non-resale-source bar (venue site suninternational.com, organiser Facebook/Instagram, and independent listing bizcommunity.com), published for its next two confirmed dates (30 Oct and 18 Dec 2026). 12 other candidates discarded for lacking independent corroboration or geographic scope.

WebFetch remained blocked by the network egress proxy this run (as last run), limiting verification to WebSearch snippets only. Searched broadly across markets, gigs, sport, theatre, family and food & drink categories. Two events cleared the 3-independent-non-resale-source bar: the Limpopo Holiday Fair at Savannah Mall (1-3 Oct 2026, corroborated by golimpopo.com/Limpopo Tourism Agency, ledet.gov.za and cdm.org.za) and the weekly Polokwane parkrun (corroborated by parkrun.co.za, the parkrun ZA blog, and the official Polokwane parkrun Facebook page). 14 other candidates discarded: several had conflicting/contradictory dates across sources (Kota Feast Polokwane claimed for 28 Nov vs the organiser's own official tour schedule placing 28 Nov in Bloemfontein; Carnival of Lights at Savannah Mall with conflicting May and October dates; a Mall of the North community day that turned out to be from October 2025 not 2026), several were in other towns outside the Polokwane metro (Robbie Wessels/Kameeldoring in Mokopane, Prisatt Boutique Hotel actually in Lephalale despite a ticketing site labelling it Polokwane, Blueberry Heights Farm in Haenertsburg, Uhuru Film Festival in Mokopane), and the rest (Run for Your Mind trail run, LBA & Elite Hoops basketball championships, Market at PLK Spring Edition) had only one or two corroborating sources rather than three independent non-resale ones.

WebFetch remained fully blocked by the network egress proxy for every domain tried (suninternational.com, cricket.co.za, pexels.com, etc.), limiting verification to WebSearch snippets only, as in prior runs. Searched broadly across markets, music, sport, theatre, food & drink, family, comedy, agricultural, art and cultural-festival categories. Only the Limpopo Holiday Fair at Savannah Mall (1-3 Oct 2026) cleared the 3-independent-non-resale-source bar (golimpopo.com/Limpopo Tourism Agency confirming the exact dates, cdm.org.za/Capricorn District Municipality confirming it as a recurring 10th-edition fair, and the provincial ledet.gov.za events calendar) -- this event was published in a prior run per the 2026-09-21 log but is absent from the current db-snapshot.json, so it is re-proposed here (safe via INSERT OR IGNORE). 14 other candidates discarded: several had conflicting dates across sources (Demi Lee Moore at Hoerskool Pietersburg claimed both Oct 2026 and Oct 2025; Carnival of Lights at Savannah Mall with conflicting May/June and October claims; a Limpopo Impalas vs Moothee Ram Tuskers cricket fixture reported as both 19-21 Nov and 22 Nov); several were out of the Polokwane metro or already past (This Is Music sing-along at Prisatt Boutique Hotel is actually in Lephalale; Botlokwa Braai Festival is ~40km outside the metro; Doek On Fleek Lekompo Fest, Polokwane Show, Mapungubwe Arts Festival and the Kaizer Chiefs-Zamalek CAF match all fell in April/Dec 2025/2026 dates already past relative to today; Market at PLK next confirmed date of 28 June 2026 already past); and the rest (Run for Your Mind trail run, Masquerade Experience Carnival Edition) had only one real corroborating source (a trail-running aggregator or event-aggregator listings) rather than three independent non-resale ones.
Events routine not due: runs weekly and last ran 2026-09-28T03:20:54Z. No search performed.

Manual forced run with direct page fetches. Found 19 candidate events; 5 cleared the 3-source non-resale bar and were published: Seshego Ultra Marathon (11 Oct, Seshego Stadium) and four Betway Premiership home matches in Polokwane (Sekhukhune United vs Marumo Gallants 17 Oct, vs Siwelele 29 Nov, vs AmaZulu 5 Dec at Peter Mokaba Stadium; Polokwane City vs Golden Arrows 16 Dec at Old Peter Mokaba). 14 discarded for lacking three independent sources (e.g. Floss Run, Moletjie Half Marathon, Bokone Challenge, ER Comedy What What at Meropa, Demi Lee Moore and Zaan Sonnekus at Hoerskool Pietersburg, Botlokwa Braai Festival, Limpopo Healing Journey Convention), or being out of area or past. Meropa's site now lists the Baobab Night Market as postponed.
